annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism (formerly Ministry of Transport), Japan
key_provisions_or_claims: Sets registration application contents and documents for Type 1 freight forwarding businesses
Sets permit and plan requirements for Type 2 businesses, including collection and delivery plans
Requires operators using automated operation freight transport to document automated driving device operating conditions
Requires documents showing expected permission for specified automated operation under the Road Traffic Act
Requires public disclosure of fees, terms and business scope on operator websites
annotation.summary_en: Japanese ministerial ordinance implementing the Freight Forwarding Business Act. It prescribes registration, permit, plan-change and notification procedures for domestic and foreign freight forwarders. Amendments add automated freight vehicle operation provisions, requiring documents on automated driving device conditions and specified automated operation permission.
annotation.title_clean: 貨物利用運送事業法施行規則
annotation.title_en: Enforcement Regulations of the Freight Forwarding Business Act
